markers.description: Monterrey International Airport in Apodaca is the main air gateway to Nuevo León and northeastern Mexico.
markers.name: Monterrey International Airport

markers.description: Hotel Galería Plaza Monterrey is a modern high-rise hotel near the Macroplaza, serving as a central base in downtown Monterrey.
markers.name: Hotel Galería Plaza Monterrey

markers.description: Palax is a long-running 24-hour diner in Monterrey's Obispado district, serving regional dishes like machacado con huevo and menudo.
markers.name: Palax

markers.description: The Macroplaza is one of the world's largest city squares, anchoring downtown Monterrey with the Faro del Comercio and government palaces.
markers.name: Macroplaza

markers.description: Once60 is a norteño grill and cultural venue by Paseo Santa Lucía in Monterrey, pairing regional barbecue with live northern music.
markers.name: Once60

markers.description: Paseo Santa Lucía is a landscaped artificial riverwalk in Monterrey linking the Macroplaza to Fundidora Park, navigable by sightseeing boats.
markers.name: Paseo Santa Lucía

markers.description: The Mexican Baseball Hall of Fame in Monterrey's Fundidora Park honors the greatest players of Mexican professional baseball and the sport's history.
markers.name: Mexican Baseball Hall of Fame

markers.description: Cinépolis Galerías Monterrey is a multiplex cinema inside the Galerías Monterrey shopping mall on the city's west side.
markers.name: Cinépolis Galerías Monterrey

markers.description: Roland Coffee Bar is a vinyl-driven listening cafe in Monterrey's Barrio Antiguo, serving specialty coffee by day and cocktails at night.
markers.name: Roland Coffee Bar

markers.description: Smart Fit Punta Cero is a branch of the Latin American budget gym chain in eastern Monterrey, offering machines and group classes.
markers.name: Smart Fit Punta Cero

markers.description: Fundidora Park is a vast public park in Monterrey built on a former steel foundry, mixing green space with industrial heritage and museums.
markers.name: Fundidora Park

markers.description: UMAMI Ramen House is a Japanese restaurant on Río Orinoco in San Pedro Garza García, serving miso ramen and gyoza.
markers.name: UMAMI Ramen House Río Orinoco

markers.description: Bendito Café is a cozy coffee shop beside the Santa Lucía riverwalk in Monterrey, serving Mexican specialty coffee, crepes, and pastries.
markers.name: Bendito Café

markers.description: Museo del Acero Horno³ is a science museum built inside a preserved blast furnace in Fundidora Park, chronicling Monterrey's steelmaking history.
markers.name: Museo del Acero Horno³

markers.description: Rufino Tamayo Park is a leafy public park in San Pedro Garza García, with jogging paths, sculptures, and weekend markets.
markers.name: Rufino Tamayo Park

markers.description: Museo La Milarca is a museum in San Pedro Garza García's Rufino Tamayo Park, exhibiting some 3,500 works of art, antiques, and numismatic pieces.
markers.name: Museo La Milarca

markers.description: Fashion Drive is an upscale shopping and dining complex in San Pedro Garza García, part of Monterrey's Valle Oriente commercial corridor.
markers.name: Fashion Drive

markers.description: Yi Hotpot is a Chinese hot pot restaurant in Plaza Áuriga, San Pedro Garza García, where diners build their own simmering broths.
markers.name: Yi Hotpot

markers.description: H-E-B Valle Oriente is a large supermarket in San Pedro Garza García, a convenient stop for groceries and travel supplies.
markers.name: H-E-B Valle Oriente

markers.description: San Huevito is a small breakfast spot in Monterrey's Obispado area, serving egg-centered sandwiches, bowls, and muffins.
markers.name: San Huevito

markers.description: The Mirador del Obispado is a hilltop lookout atop Cerro del Obispado, offering panoramic views of Monterrey beneath a giant Mexican flag.
markers.name: Mirador del Obispado

markers.description: Casa Azul Spa's Obispado branch in Monterrey offers therapeutic massages and body treatments using quartz, stones, and chocolate, as well as mezcal rituals.
markers.name: Casa Azul Spa Obispado

markers.description: Taquería Orinoco's Centrito Valle branch serves the Monterrey-born chain's famous norteño-style trompo, res, and chicharrón tacos in San Pedro Garza García.
markers.name: Taquería Orinoco Centrito Valle

markers.description: El Gaucho is an Argentine steakhouse operating in Monterrey since 1968, serving mesquite-grilled cuts, churrasco, and empanadas.
markers.name: El Gaucho

markers.description: Casamor is a cafe and fondita in San Pedro Garza García, serving chilaquiles, huevos motuleños, and fluffy pancakes at breakfast.
markers.name: Casamor

markers.description: Chipinque Ecological Park is a forested reserve in the Sierra Madre above San Pedro Garza García, offering hiking trails and city views.
markers.name: Chipinque Ecological Park

markers.description: El Gran Pastor is a classic Monterrey restaurant on Avenida Gonzalitos, renowned for cabrito, the region's signature roast kid goat.
markers.name: El Gran Pastor

markers.description: Lu'um Coffee Shop is an espresso bar in central Monterrey that doubles as a boutique flower and gift shop.
markers.name: Lu'um Coffee Shop

markers.description: The Mexican History Museum beside the Santa Lucía riverwalk in Monterrey traces Mexico's story from pre-Hispanic civilizations to the modern era.
markers.name: Mexican History Museum
